numbers.formula: v5 (2026-10-19 13:52, package BF2): N = (Base + L/levelLinDiv) x (1 + L/levelDiv) for L >= 1, Base - zeroPenalty at Level 0; Base = base + perRarity x Rarity + perWait x W + perWait2 x W^2 + perLumber x Lumber + perLumber2 x Lumber^2 + perRitual x Ritual points. levelLinDiv 5 (the owner offered 3, 4 or 5). perLevel is v3 (N = Base + perLevel x L), kept for comparisons

v6.formula: (Base + L/10) × (1 + L/30), Base + 0.2 × Map (Map term added here: the helper has none yet)
